Keyboard shortcuts

Ctrl K or /Command palette: items, documents, sections, diagrams, commands
g then d g m h i rGo to dashboard, graph, matrix, history, diagrams, regression runs
[ ]Previous or next work item of the same type
sStar or unstar the current item
tToggle light and dark theme
bToggle the sidebar
cToggle compact table density
Alt ←Back inside the inspector
EscClose inspector, palette, lightbox or graph focus
?This overlay
Hover any IDPreview card. Click opens the inspector; Ctrl-click opens the full page
GraphWheel to zoom, drag to pan, click a node to focus, click again to release
